items.headline: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
items.excerpt: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident

items.headline: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
items.excerpt: Trump contradicted his own government's intelligence officials, who reportedly concluded that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy.

items.headline: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’
items.excerpt: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.

items.headline: FBI says Artex AI open-source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
items.excerpt: The FBI says that the open-source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.

items.headline: Jordan Belfort’s new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the ‘Wolf of Wall Street’
items.excerpt: Belfort claims his AI sales voice can already close deals almost as well as the best human salespeople, and he thinks it will catch up in a year.

items.headline: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
items.excerpt: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, but restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about their independence.

items.headline: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
items.excerpt: ChatGPT will ban an account trying to access CSAM content for 24 hours as a warning

items.headline: Audible turns to AI to help users discover audiobooks
items.excerpt: Audible's new AI-generated audio previews summarize a book's themes and what readers liked about it, in addition to playing the narrated sample.

items.headline: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
items.excerpt: Under the interim rule, the U.S. will require firms to get licenses to export AI chips if they may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.

items.headline: Google Maps can now build trip itineraries with real-time details about each stop
items.excerpt: You could use Ask Maps to plan a holiday shopping day trip or something more complex, like a three-day road trip featuring coastal hikes and oceanfront dining.

items.headline: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
items.excerpt: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.

items.headline: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
items.excerpt: Apple's new app for a study will answer everyday medical questions

items.headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
items.excerpt: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies, including General Atomics.

items.headline: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
items.excerpt: "Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia."

items.headline: ‘SNL’ gathers all the tech tycoons for a lesson in dating and spycraft
items.excerpt: While awkward, creepy tech executives have become a recurring theme on Saturday Night Live, this week’s episode gave the cast a chance to show off all their impressions at once.

items.headline: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.excerpt: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

items.headline: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.excerpt: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

items.headline: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
items.excerpt: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.

items.headline: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.excerpt: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
